name: Tigrinya QA Dataset
description: A native question-answering dataset for the low-resourced East African language Tigrinya, containing 10.6K question-answer pairs from 572 paragraphs across 290 news articles. It aims to enable QA research in Tigrinya and related languages, providing a challenging benchmark with strong baseline models.
reputation: A low-resource language QA benchmark that is useful for Tigrinya research, but it is not yet a widely standardized benchmark in the broader NLP community.
notes: Dataset covers diverse topics; human performance estimated at 92% F1; dataset and leaderboard publicly available.
